verdict.rationale: Convex's docs describe first-party TypeScript/JavaScript integration across many frameworks (React, Next.js, Remix, TanStack Start, React Native, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte). They also document an official Convex Auth library, CLI-generated types with end-to-end type safety, and an `npm create convex` scaffold, which together amount to official SDK-style tooling that agents can build against. missing for 10: explicit SDK reference documentation, evidence of non-JS language SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
